glass_felix: Pattern is inconsistent location. Day 3 11:34 (AM) was at kitchen_table_k1 (assumed sink_k1). Day 3 22:59 (PM) was at cupboard_k1 (assumed counter_k1). Previous notes suggested counter_k1 for PM, but today’s PM evidence shows cupboard_k1. Do not assume counter_k1 for evening. Check kitchen_table_k1 in morning, cupboard_k1 in evening.
